operations.description: Create PostgreSQL with retained storage when deployed.

prerequisites.description: Provide a Docker engine with Compose 2.30 or later.
Make image magic-infra-compose-app:fixture available for service compose-app.
Provide credentials reference fixture-db for resource primary-db.
